facts.statement: Huehuecanauhtlus is a hadrosauroid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of western Mexico.
facts.quote: Huehuecanauhtlus is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur known from the Late Cretaceous (Santonian stage) of Michoacán, western Mexico.

facts.statement: Huehuecanauhtlus was a medium-sized hadrosaur that measured 6 meters long and weighed between 1 and 1.4 metric tons.
facts.quote: Huehuecanauhtlus was a medium-sized hadrosaur, measuring 6 m long and weighing around 1 - 1.4 MT.

facts.statement: Researchers estimated Huehuecanauhtlus to be 6 meters long, 2.3 meters high, and weigh 1.5 tons.
facts.quote: Se ha estimado para Huehuecanauhtlus un largo de 6 metros, un alto de 2,3 y un peso de 1,5 toneladas.

facts.statement: Huehuecanauhtlus is known only from two fossil individuals.
facts.quote: Huehuecanauhtlus is known only from two individuals.

facts.statement: Huehuecanauhtlus was first described and named in 2012 by Angel Alejandro Ramírez-Velasco and colleagues.
facts.quote: Huehuecanauhtlus was first described and named by Angel Alejandro Ramírez-Velasco, Mouloud Benammi, Albert Prieto-Márquez, Jesús Alvarado Ortega and René Hernández-Rivera in 2012

facts.statement: The generic name Huehuecanauhtlus is derived from Náhuatl words meaning "ancient" and "duck".
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from Náhuatl (group of dialects related to the Aztecan languages) huehuetl, meaning "ancient" and canauhtli, meaning "duck" in reference to its hadrosauroid affinities.

facts.statement: The correct pronunciation of the generic name is "UEUE-CANA-UHh-TLUS".
facts.quote: La pronunciación correcta del nombre genérico es "UEUE-CANA-UHh-TLUS".

facts.statement: The specific name tiquichensis honors the town of Tiquicheo.
facts.quote: El nombre específico honra al pueblo de Tiquicheo.

facts.statement: Fossils of Huehuecanauhtlus date to the Santonian stage of the Late Cretaceous, approximately 85.8 to 83.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: The holotype came from the sixth fossiliferous spot, whereas the paratype came from the third spot, of an unnamed formation, dating to the Santonian stage of the Late Cretaceous period, about 85.8–83.5 million years ago.

facts.statement: Huehuecanauhtlus lived between 86.8 and 84 million years ago in the Cutzamala Formation of Michoacán, Mexico.
facts.quote: que vivió durante el período Cretácico superior (Santoniense), hace entre 86,8 y 84 millones de años, en la Formación Cutzamala de Michoacán, México.

facts.statement: Reconstructions suggest Huehuecanauhtlus lived in the arid paramos that dominated the Cutzamala Formation.
facts.quote: Recreación en vida de un individuo mostrado en los páramos áridos que predominaban la Formación Cutzamala.

facts.statement: Both known specimens were collected at the Barranca Los Bonetes locality in Tuzantla, Michoacán.
facts.quote: Both specimens were collected at the Barranca Los Bonetes locality in Tuzantla, Michoacán.

facts.statement: Pathologies have been observed on the vertebrae and dorsal ribs of the holotype specimen IGM 6253.
facts.quote: Vértebra y costilla dorsal del espécimen IGM 6253, con patologías.

facts.statement: Excluding Claosaurus, Jeyawati, Levnesovia, Nanyangosaurus, Shuangmiaosaurus, and Telmatosaurus results in a more resolved phylogenetic topology for Huehuecanauhtlus.
facts.quote: La exclusión de Claosaurus, Jeyawati, Levnesovia, Nanyangosaurus, Shuangmiaosaurus y Telmatosaurus de la politomía resulta en una topología mejor resuelta.
